title.zh-CN: 脐血白细胞明显升高 · 18小时龄男婴
title.en: Markedly raised cord-blood white cells · boy aged 18 hours

summary.zh-CN: 足月新生儿因储存脐血时发现异常血象转诊，需要区分反应性变化与克隆性疾病。
summary.en: A term newborn is referred after an abnormal blood count during cord-blood storage assessment; distinguish reactive changes from clonal disease.

provenance.citation: 刘兆娥, 陈鲁, 朱学梅. 生后脐血检查发现先天性淋巴细胞白血病一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(01):72-73. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.01.016.

text.zh-CN: 住院后出现出血点，第四天腰骶部紫红结节未获活检，之后低热、反应变差；第9天家属放弃治疗出院，随访得知生后45天死亡。
text.en: Petechiae developed after admission; a violaceous lumbosacral nodule on day 4 was not biopsied, followed by low fever and reduced responsiveness. The family withdrew treatment on day 9; follow-up reported death at 45 days of life.

prompt.zh-CN: 极高白细胞伴大量原始细胞应优先怎样解释？
prompt.en: How should extreme leucocytosis with abundant blasts be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑恶性原始细胞增殖，需紧急血液专科分类
text.en: Strongly suspect malignant blast proliferation requiring urgent haematological classification

feedback.zh-CN: 持续极高计数、原始细胞优势及肝脾肿大支持这一方向。
feedback.en: Persistently extreme counts, blast predominance and organ enlargement support this approach.

text.zh-CN: 归因于出生应激，无需复查
text.en: Attribute everything to birth stress without further assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 出生应激不能充分解释持续约500×10^9/L的白细胞和90%以上原始细胞。
feedback.en: Birth stress does not adequately explain counts around 500 × 10^9/L with over 90% blasts.

text.zh-CN: 只凭白细胞高即可确诊细菌感染
text.en: Diagnose bacterial infection from leucocytosis alone

feedback.zh-CN: 细胞形态和分群信息不能被一个计数替代。
feedback.en: A count cannot replace cell morphology and population assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: B系标记支持B淋巴母细胞白血病，阴性融合筛查不排除所有遗传异常
text.en: B-lineage markers support B-lymphoblastic leukaemia; negative screening does not exclude every genetic abnormality

feedback.zh-CN: CD19和胞浆CD79a提供分系依据，筛查阴性只涵盖已测目标。
feedback.en: CD19 and cytoplasmic CD79a support lineage; negative screening covers only tested targets.

text.zh-CN: POX阴性直接证明急性髓系白血病
text.en: Negative POX proves acute myeloid leukaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告免疫分型指向B系，不能反向解读POX。
feedback.en: The immunophenotype indicates B lineage; POX cannot be interpreted in reverse.

text.zh-CN: 核型正常便说明没有遗传因素
text.en: A normal karyotype establishes the absence of genetic factors

feedback.zh-CN: 常规核型与有限融合筛查均有检测边界。
feedback.en: Conventional karyotyping and limited fusion panels have detection limits.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何向家属讨论接下来的安全方向？
prompt.en: How should the next safe course be discussed with the family?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 紧急新生儿血液肿瘤联合评估，同时解释风险、治疗选择与未解决信息
text.en: Urgent neonatal-haematology assessment with clear discussion of risks, options and uncertainties

feedback.zh-CN: 婴儿年龄和极高白细胞属于高风险特征，需要专科个体化评估。
feedback.en: Infancy and extreme leucocytosis are high-risk features requiring specialist assessment.

text.zh-CN: 因暂时精神好而仅常规随访
text.en: Use routine follow-up because responsiveness is initially good

feedback.zh-CN: 外观相对稳定不能抵消血液学危险信号。
feedback.en: A relatively stable appearance does not negate the haematological danger signals.

text.zh-CN: 依据旧单例结局宣布所有现代治疗均无效
text.en: Declare all modern treatment futile from this old case outcome

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告未接受完整治疗，其结局不能代表当前婴儿ALL治疗效果。
feedback.en: The report did not document full treatment; its outcome cannot represent current infant ALL care.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明原始细胞优势比单独白细胞计数更有分类意义。；承认结节病理、完整分子分型、现代方案治疗反应及死因。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Blast predominance adds more classification information than the count alone.; acknowledge Nodule histology, comprehensive molecular classification, response to modern therapy and cause of death. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告诊断先天性B淋巴细胞白血病，极高白细胞、肝脾大和B系免疫表型构成关键证据。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed congenital B-lymphoblastic leukaemia, supported by extreme leucocytosis, hepatosplenomegaly and B-lineage immunophenotyping.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原始细胞优势比单独白细胞计数更有分类意义。
keyReasoning.en: Blast predominance adds more classification information than the count alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性分子筛查不能超出其靶标范围解释。
keyReasoning.en: A negative molecular screen must be interpreted within its target coverage.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 早期外观好不能排除严重血液病。
keyReasoning.en: A reassuring early appearance cannot exclude severe haematological disease.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 将持续极高白细胞与细胞形态和免疫分型整合。
teachingPoints.en: Integrate sustained extreme counts with morphology and immunophenotype.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分诊断依据和未经活检的皮肤浸润推测。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish diagnostic evidence from unbiopsied suspected skin infiltration.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 现代风险评估不能以历史未完整治疗的结局代替。
teachingPoints.en: Current risk assessment cannot be replaced by the outcome of historical incomplete treatment.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
